note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Fianna Fáil-Progressive Democrats minority coalition under Bertie Ahern during the economic boom), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: employers and unions inside national social partnership agreements, a historically influential Catholic Church, a significant farming sector, and small civilian-controlled Defence Forces.
